explication: Ontology Playground is a static React application for exploring, designing, learning about, and sharing Fabric IQ ontologies. A user can open a catalogue ontology, inspect and search its graph, query it in natural language, or edit a draft and import/export RDF. The README also documents learning courses, quests, embeddable viewing, and catalogue contributions. Edges follow excerpted calls or explicit README capabilities; some documented subsystems lack sampled implementation details, so their internal wiring is not asserted.
